articles.title: People Have 'No Idea' How Much Nvidia Impacts Daily Life, Says Aaron Brown
articles.description: Aaron Brown, founder and CEO of Lumbra, said that the average person has 'no idea' how much Nvidia impacts their lives and that it remains a messaging issue the AI industry at large needs to solve. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Arm Is Up 77% Even As Profit Fell
articles.description: If you had tuned in only for the legal headlines around Arm and Qualcomm, you might assume Arm’s shareholders were punished, not rewarded. Holding Arm from the start of the year would have returned 77.3%, including dividends. That gain came through a period that featured sector selloffs, supply concerns, and valuation debates.
